title: Car Repair Shop
statementMd:
Polycarp starts his own business. Tomorrow will be the first working day of his car repair shop. For now the car repair shop is very small and only one car can be repaired at a given time.

Polycarp is good at marketing, so he has already collected $*n*$ requests from clients. The requests are numbered from $1$ to $*n*$ in order they came.

The $*i*$-th request is characterized by two values: $*s*_{*i*}$ — the day when a client wants to start the repair of his car, $*d*_{*i*}$ — duration (in days) to repair the car. The days are enumerated from 1, the first day is tomorrow, the second day is the day after tomorrow and so on.

Polycarp is making schedule by processing requests in the order from the first to the $*n*$-th request. He schedules the $*i*$-th request as follows:

- If the car repair shop is idle for $*d*_{*i*}$ days starting from $*s*_{*i*}$ ($*s*_{*i*}, *s*_{*i*} + 1, ..., *s*_{*i*} + *d*_{*i*} - 1$), then these days are used to repair a car of the $*i*$-th client.
- Otherwise, Polycarp finds the first day $*x*$ (from 1 and further) that there are $*d*_{*i*}$ subsequent days when no repair is scheduled starting from $*x*$. In other words he chooses the smallest positive $*x*$ that all days $*x*, *x* + 1, ..., *x* + *d*_{*i*} - 1$ are not scheduled for repair of any car. So, the car of the $*i*$-th client will be repaired in the range $[*x*, *x* + *d*_{*i*} - 1]$. It is possible that the day $*x*$ when repair is scheduled to start will be less than $*s*_{*i*}$.

Given $*n*$ requests, you are asked to help Polycarp schedule all of them according to the rules above.

## Input

The first line contains integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 200$) — the number of requests from clients.

The following $*n*$ lines contain requests, one request per line. The $*i*$-th request is given as the pair of integers $*s*_{*i*}, *d*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *s*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$, $1 ≤ *d*_{*i*} ≤ 5·10^{6}$), where $*s*_{*i*}$ is the preferred time to start repairing the $*i*$-th car, $*d*_{*i*}$ is the number of days to repair the $*i*$-th car.

The requests should be processed in the order they are given in the input.

## Output

Print $*n*$ lines. The $*i*$-th line should contain two integers — the start day to repair the $*i*$-th car and the finish day to repair the $*i*$-th car.
statementZhMd:
Polycarp 开始了自己的事业。明天将是他的汽车修理店开业的第一个工作日。目前，汽车修理店很小，同一时间只能修理一辆汽车。

Polycarp 很擅长市场营销，因此他已经收集了客户的 $*n*$ 个请求。这些请求按照到达顺序编号为 $1$ 到 $*n*$。

第 $*i*$ 个请求由两个值描述：$*s*_{*i*}$——客户希望开始修理汽车的日期；$*d*_{*i*}$——修理汽车所需的时长（天数）。日期从 1 开始编号：第一天是明天，第二天是后天，以此类推。

Polycarp 按照从第一个请求到第 $*n*$ 个请求的顺序处理请求，并按如下方式安排第 $*i*$ 个请求：

- 如果汽车修理店从 $*s*_{*i*}$ 开始连续 $*d*_{*i*}$ 天均空闲（即 $*s*_{*i*}, *s*_{*i*} + 1, ..., *s*_{*i*} + *d*_{*i*} - 1$ 这些天），那么就使用这些天为第 $*i*$ 位客户修理汽车。
- 否则，Polycarp 会寻找第一个日期 $*x*$（从 1 开始向后查找），使得从 $*x*$ 开始连续的 $*d*_{*i*}$ 天内没有安排任何修理。换句话说，他选择满足日期 $*x*, *x* + 1, ..., *x* + *d*_{*i*} - 1$ 均未安排修理的最小正整数 $*x*$。因此，第 $*i*$ 位客户的汽车将在区间 $[*x*, *x* + *d*_{*i*} - 1]$ 内进行修理。修理开始日期 $*x*$ 可能小于 $*s*_{*i*}$。

给定 $*n*$ 个请求，请你帮助 Polycarp 按照上述规则安排所有请求。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 200$），表示客户请求的数量。

接下来的 $*n*$ 行每行包含一个请求。第 $*i*$ 个请求由一对整数 $*s*_{*i*}, *d*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *s*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$，$1 ≤ *d*_{*i*} ≤ 5·10^{6}$）给出，其中 $*s*_{*i*}$ 是客户希望开始修理第 $*i*$ 辆汽车的日期，$*d*_{*i*}$ 是修理第 $*i*$ 辆汽车所需的天数。

请求必须按照它们在输入中的给出顺序进行处理。

## 输出格式

输出 $*n*$ 行。第 $*i*$ 行应包含两个整数——修理第 $*i*$ 辆汽车的开始日期和结束日期。
